name: Pink Slip Kings: Drag Racing
description:
Build it. Tune it. Race for pink slips.

Pink Slip Kings is a 3D drag racing game built around manual launches, precise shifts and deep car tuning. Build your garage, climb through five car classes and compete in career races and tournaments.

NAIL THE LAUNCH
Watch the starting lights, choose your launch RPM and time your shifts. Balance power and tire grip to improve your reaction time, elapsed time and trap speed.

BUILD AND TUNE
Upgrade your engine, drivetrain, tires and suspension. Adjust gear ratios, final drive, boost, launch RPM and more. Compare horsepower and torque on the dyno, then take your setup to Test & Tune.

RACE FOR PINK SLIPS
Stake earned in-game cash in money races or put a car on the line in a pink-slip race. Win and take your rival's ride; lose and give up yours. In-game currency and cars cannot be purchased or exchanged for real money.

CAREER AND TOURNAMENTS
Progress from D class to S class, enter elimination tournaments and work toward the Kings Series. Practice launches and shifts, build a faster car and improve your personal bests.

MAKE IT YOURS
Customize your cars with paint, rims, decals and body parts. Explore a tuner sandbox with cars and parts unlocked.

FEATURES
• 3D drag racing with manual launch and shift controls
• Career, tournaments, money races and pink-slip races
• Performance upgrades and detailed tuning
• Dyno, telemetry and race time slips
• Test & Tune and tuner sandbox modes
• Car customization and multiple camera views
• Offline play
• No ads and no in-app purchases

Every car and performance part is earned through gameplay.
